templates.title: PHP Ledger
templates.description: Self-hosted double-entry accounting: invoices, expenses, point of sale and a full general ledger, installed non-interactively with its own MySQL 8.4 database. Deploys the same compose.production.yaml this repository publishes at the root (docs/CONTAINER.md).
templates.note: Set PL_DB_PASSWORD and PL_DB_ROOT_PASSWORD before deploying; there is no default. Leave every PL_ADMIN_* variable blank to finish setup in the browser at /install instead of from the environment. After deploying, enable HTTPS in front of this stack and set PL_PUBLIC_URL to the real address before exposing it beyond your own machine.

env.name: PL_DB_PASSWORD
env.label: Database password
env.description: Required. A strong password for the phpledger MySQL user; shared by the web and db services.

env.name: PL_DB_ROOT_PASSWORD
env.label: Database root password
env.description: Required. A separate strong password for the MySQL root account.

env.name: PL_PUBLIC_URL
env.label: Public URL
env.description: This installation's own address, shown on-screen and used for links. Set to the real https:// address before exposing this beyond your own machine.

env.name: PL_ADMIN_EMAIL
env.label: Admin email (optional)
env.description: Set together with Admin name and Admin password to create the owner account on first start. Leave all three blank to finish setup in the browser at /install instead.

env.name: PL_ADMIN_USERNAME
env.label: Admin username (optional)
env.description: Login username. Defaults from Admin email when left blank.

env.name: PL_ADMIN_PASSWORD
env.label: Admin password (optional)
env.description: Required only when installing the owner account from the environment (see Admin email). Never shared or logged; read directly from the environment by install/create-admin.php.

env.name: PL_AUTO_MIGRATE
env.label: Apply pending migrations on start
env.description: Set to 1 for one restart after pulling a newer image tag, so pending migrations apply before the new code serves traffic (docs/CONTAINER.md, "Upgrade"). Safe to leave at 0 or 1 otherwise.

env.name: PL_VERSION
env.label: Image tag
env.description: The published ghcr.io/phpledger/phpledger tag to deploy. Always a concrete version, never latest.

env.name: PL_WEB_PORT
env.label: Host port
env.description: The host port the web service publishes.
